name: Jacob Oberholtzer Kolb
milestones: Death: 28 June 1818, Kulpsville, Montgomery County, PA
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Son of Peter Kolb. Father of Abraham Clemens Kulp. Source: Irmagene Kulp Zacher, Kulp Family Lineage.

Open question: Peter Kolb is listed as born 1718, married 1748 and died 1748, yet his son Jacob Oberholtzer Kolb was born 7 Mar 1740. The marriage year or birth dates may be wrong [Family research emails, email 23]
